claim_boundary: Four native executions of one authored graph and fixed memory: reproduction2, new signal-bundle interventions2, independent discovery/training/feedback0. Finite two points only. No exact threshold, monotonicity, bifurcation, unique fixed point, removal of all recurrence/bistability, isolated edge/gain/self-excitation cause, LLM internals, human cognition, biology, energy or hardware efficiency claims.
first_network_definition: Earliest r02_network(kind=decision) in journal event order; settled event and creation advance identified by transition event_start <= event_index < event_end. Exclude all pools and pre-network progress(network_id=None).
measurements: Every decision network and generation half-open event range; convergence/status/goal/margin/residual/stable steps/ticks and all routes
candidate False/True/None, pending.value/ready, graph_complete and frontier; pre-network progress excluded from first metric
Proof.paths inventory vs Proof.final parent closure, independently recomputed D_DAG, raw decision, grounding readout and terminal adoption

slot [e2,e3,e0,e1]; program digest, drives e:1=4*score, goal dependency closure, all synchronous link last_tick_centered_link_input vs terminal_centered_link_term vs terminal_uncentered_activation_product
All integer counters separately; native active/finish/finished decision/capture intervals separate, pool metrics null/non-applicable; stage UTC and monotonic durations; actual energy/peak memory null
measures_note: Link records separately store would-be centered term, transmitted flag, actual last-tick input (0 for disabled link), terminal-centered term and uncentered weight*activation. Goal dependency inventory is provenance, not an effect metric.
not_evaluable: Per-arm stable predicates evaluate only stable_true/stable_false/stable_ambiguous; budget_exhausted, oscillating, unsupported or missing do not count as False. Pair category predicate requires both stable-evaluable. Numeric goal difference requires both measured settled states, even if nonstable; its result never establishes convergence. Exists supports on a stable changed witness; absence falsifies only if both pairs stable-evaluable. Universal numeric predicate falsifies on a measured equal pair; no such pair supports only if both measured. Missing mapping/tick/settled is measurement failure and stops apparatus.

category_change_exists.expected: At least one of the two stable-evaluable pairs changes first category
category_change_exists.rationale: Paired form of the .03 category prediction; same two cells, not an independent support count.

numeric_difference_both.expected: For each pair absolute first goal difference exceeds numeric_tolerance
numeric_difference_both.rationale: Both trajectories lose active inter-node feedback; numeric differences are distinct from category changes and are not independent samples.

remove_bundle_s003_true.expected: False arm at .03 has stable_true, candidate_value True, ready True, matching progress absent
remove_bundle_s003_true.rationale: Without downward feedback the weak edge retains its positive external drive; hypothesized removal of a negative feedback trajectory. Directional conjecture from source, no pilot or fixed-point proof.

remove_bundle_s004_true.expected: False arm at .04 has stable_true, candidate_value True, ready True, matching progress absent
remove_bundle_s004_true.rationale: The .04 True baseline is already stable_true; removing the bundle is predicted to retain this category, not its numeric trajectory.

readout_definition: candidate_value only for stable_decision and not all-zero/None unsupported; >=0.5 true else false. ready = candidate_value is True or graph_complete. Pending value retained only if true or false with complete graph. progress event absent when true or false+complete; otherwise negative_requires_dependency_coverage for false, unresolved_or_no_goal_candidate for None.
signal_intervention: All kind=top_down link transmissions skipped only when top_down=False; stored Program/groups/links/weights and matched first-network digest unchanged; self_excitation and inhibition remain. Subsequent path/frontier/proof/cost can naturally differ.
stopping_rule: Exactly four cells once: .03 True/False, .04 True/False, use_circuits False. Same max_ticks160/max_advances16/session ticks5120, no retry, added cells, pilot, budget extension, training or feedback. Scientific ambiguous/oscillation/network/session-budget outcomes remain separate. A designated external reviewer must pass the frozen design before the first cell and each completed cell before the next cell; the last cell also requires review before finalization. Resume executes at most one unexecuted cell and never retries partial output. Integrity/runtime/measurement errors stop and preserve partial packets, first failure and traceback.
